svg.title: Tape and heap: the same respond workload
svg.desc: Recorded: tape 0.67 seconds and 1.7 MB; heap 1.55 seconds and 7.6 MB. Playback is 5 times slower. Each block represents 0.05 MB: 34 tape blocks, 152 heap blocks. Median of nine runs, 1.6 million DTOs.
svg.text: * Illustration only: the heap does not actually fill in this random order.
Playback 5x slower; labels show measured time. Median of 9 runs.
Allocation layout is schematic; 1 block = 0.05 MB; 34 tape / 152 heap blocks.
